author: More Perfect Union
description:
Democrats are about to have a chance to end the Iran War.

On December 11th funding for the war runs out, and if Democrats are willing to stick to their guns and even shut down the government, Congress could choose to reassert themselves and not hand Trump more money for war.

The midterm blue wave was in large part a response to the deep unpopularity of Trump’s war on Iran.

Now Democrats could act on that, reclaim some Congressional power over warmaking, and cut the train on money Trump is dumping into his misguided war that even he claims “is effectively over”.

Producer: @trevorp_hayes
Editor: @niklaak
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: How Democrats can end the Iran War before even taking power
